whatWasProven.method: Verifier reads both live source contracts and the release plan.
whatWasProven.result: PASS. Both exact candidate revisions are canonical under separate Olli approval records and decision IDs; both are release-eligible inputs to PORT-03.

whatWasProven.claim: Raw operating-proof media cannot enter the release through this plan.
whatWasProven.method: Verifier validates the proof payload schema/example, compares all four provenance hashes and rejects any release-eligible record without a reviewed redacted derivative.
whatWasProven.result: PASS. The example contains no original paths, original bytes, derivative paths, derivative hashes or approval and is explicitly publicReleaseEligible false.

whatWasProven.claim: Clean install, version visibility, update and rollback have executable acceptance conditions.

whatWasProven.result: PASS. The plan requires a package-only temporary copy, no checkout or network dependency, deterministic integrity, eight viewports, accessibility/fallback checks, visible version/hash and immutable rollback.

whatWasProven.method: Plan inspection and Git diff scope.
whatWasProven.result: PASS. CON-MEZ-SYSTEMS-WEB-001 is named, its repository remains null pending registration, cross-repository runtime imports are forbidden and no consumer repository was read or modified.

whatWasProven.claim: Current decision authority drift is visible rather than laundered into a production plan.
whatWasProven.method: PORT-02 compared the immutable cutover ledger, the three signed supporting records and the new post-cutover supplement; the release-boundary verifier rechecks the IDs, base-ledger path and source paths.
whatWasProven.result: PASS. The cutover ledger retains its exact activated hash. The supplement indexes the three prior approvals plus DEC-HALFTONE-PORTRAIT-COMPONENT-001 and DEC-TESTIMONIAL-MARQUEE-COMPONENT-001, each pointing to its bounded Olli approval record.

knownGaps: No production release has been assembled or copied into isolation; that is TASK-PORT-03 work.
No operating-proof derivative has been redacted or visually approved; the current four screenshots remain evidence-only.
CMP-06 retains explicitly accepted VoiceOver, physical-pointer and device-performance follow-ups for the named consumer; follower counts are frozen dated evidence.
The named production-web consumer has no registered repository or consumer proof yet.
Third-party mark packaging still requires a bounded legal/attribution inclusion decision; the current registry is reference-only with productionAuthority false.
humanDecisionsRequired: Approve the exact redacted operating-proof derivative bytes before public release.
authorityScope: Agent-owned release boundary only. It creates no component decision, production authority, generated release, deployment or consumer authority.
